lines: Cyrus Jamshed Guzder may sell up to 132,000 shares, with proceeds up to ₹17.85 crore if all offered shares are sold.
Proceeds have been in hand since 11 Mar 2026, 248 days ago, so the trigger is old rather than recent.
Gain is up to ₹13.36 crore before offer expenses and taxes; employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so proceeds are slightly lower.
Confidence is medium: name verified in the seller table, but holdings appear in one section only.
